title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta5

## Prepared History build diagnostics

This beta is intentionally diagnostic-only for the Prepared History cold-build path discovered while testing 0.4.6-beta4.

0.4.6-beta4 confirmed that recurring active-session metadata/tail work is now cheap, but one X390 retained-session Prepared History build took about 78 seconds. Beta5 adds enough privacy-safe timing and point-count detail to identify where that cold-build time is spent before changing the rendering algorithm.

### Added diagnostics

Prepared History diagnostics now include:

- retained completed-session point total;
- maximum retained session point count;
- source point count for the most recent cold build;
- rendered route point count for the most recent build;
- cache-miss reason;
- build reason (prewarm or legacy);
- total prewarm duration;
- per-build session load, cache load, session copy, executor render, validation reload, Store save and resource publication timing;
- render-stage profile for route split, swath rasterization, boundary tracing, SVG path encoding and artifact assembly;
- source/cutting/travel segment counts, occupied raster cell count and boundary loop count.

These fields contain counts, timings and reasons only. Route geometry is not added to Download diagnostics.

### Behavior

- Prepared History output format and rendering algorithm are unchanged.
- No route samples are capped, discarded or simplified differently.
- Existing prepared archives remain reusable.
- MQTT, Schedule, Resume, mower commands and Map API behavior are unchanged.
